Related insight: Related insight: Tutorial 12 (wasp_12) continues directly from tutorial 11, extending the RuleGenerator series with further rule-grammar and generative-assembly techniques. Tutorial 11 is a direct prerequisite for tutorial 12, and the two share closely related content around multi-part advanced aggregation with rule-generator workflows.

Related insight: Related insight: Tutorial 13 (wasp_13) further extends the RuleGenerator series beyond tutorial 12, continuing the advanced multi-part aggregation and rule-grammar workflow. Tutorial 11 is thus an indirect prerequisite for tutorial 13 as well.

Related insight: Related insight: Tutorial 14 (wasp_14) continues the advanced topics series beyond tutorial 13, extending the multi-part aggregation and rule-grammar progression further. Tutorial 11 is thus an indirect prerequisite for the advanced topics explored in tutorial 14 via the chain 11 → 12 → 13 → 14.

Related insight: Related insight: The advanced multi-part aggregation series that includes tutorial 11 extends well beyond tutorial 14, progressing through a dedicated constraints sub-series that includes tutorial 29 (wasp_29), which covers constraint-based stochastic aggregation with adjacency and connection-configuration rules. Tutorial 11 is thus an indirect prerequisite for this extended constraints progression.

evolution_history.changes: wasp_11 is the direct predecessor to wasp_12 and its context was empty. The new pattern introduces the RuleGenerator series continuation, which should be reflected in wasp_11's context and tags.
Tutorial 11 is the starting point of the RuleGenerator series; tutorial 13 is a further continuation, so tutorial 11's context should acknowledge that the series now extends to tutorial 13.

wasp_11 currently notes tutorials 12 and 13 as successors in the RuleGenerator series. Since wasp_14 continues after tutorial 13, the full sequence extends to 14, and this context helps learners understand the complete learning path.
wasp_29 extends the known series beyond what was previously documented in wasp_11's context.

curriculum.title: RULE GENERATOR #01
curriculum.text:
RULE GENERATOR #01
The RuleGenerator component allows to quickly
generate aggregation rules without the need to
type them one by one.
By default, the Generator creates rules between
each part and each connection available in the
aggregation.
The SELF_P input allows to decide if a part is allowed
to connect to itself (Must be True for aggregations with
only one part type).
The SELF_C input allows to decide if a connection is 
allowed to connect to itself.
